name: Dynamic programming
intuition: Write down the answers to smaller versions of the problem, then build each bigger answer from those notes.

variants.name: One row of answers
variants.summary: The answer for position i uses the answers for a few earlier positions.
variants.requires: Each answer depends only on earlier ones.

variants.name: Best over choices
variants.summary: At each size, try every last choice and keep the best combination.
variants.requires: A choice leaves a smaller problem of the same kind.

variants.name: Best ending here
variants.summary: For each position, compute the best answer that ends exactly there.
variants.requires: An answer ending at i extends an answer ending earlier.

variants.name: A table of answers
variants.summary: Fill a 2D table where each cell uses its neighbours above and to the left.
variants.requires: Moves only go one way, so cells can be filled in order.

visual.caption: The ways to reach step 4 are the ways to reach step 3 (then one step) plus the ways to reach step 2 (then two steps): 3 + 2.
